GFL Environmental Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend

 

MIAMI BEACH, FL, September 29, 2026 – GFL Environmental Inc. (NYSE: GFL) (TSX: GFL) (“GFL” or the “Company”) today announced that the Board of Directors of the Company has declared a cash dividend of US$0.0169 for each outstanding subordinate voting share and multiple voting share of the Company for the third quarter of 2026.

 

The cash dividend will be paid on October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 14, 2026. The Company has designated this dividend as an eligible dividend within the meaning of the Income Tax Act (Canada).

 

About GFL

 

GFL is the fourth largest diversified environmental services company in North America, providing comprehensive solid waste management services from its platform of facilities throughout Canada and 19 U.S. states. GFL has a workforce of more than 17,000 employees across its organization.
